reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: Hey, Im also confirming that their billing tactics are shady as hell. Only paid the 1€ out of curiosity, but when I tried to unsubscribe, it was an insane amount of steps and took me quite some time to figure it out (and im pretty technically skilled, I can't imagine an older person doing it). Basically they let you pay before you even have an account or password, so its very hard to cancel, when there's nothing to cancel:) I had to create the account that was  pre-linked with my card details. The app didn't let me choose a password, so I had to ,,reset it'' and then create it. The subscribtion also isn't linked with AppStore (if you take the test via Instagram for example). Now reading the other reviews, I really hope I won't be charged more money by the end of the trial. Really, what a shame that the spiritual community is filled with scammers who prey on the curious.
reviews.reply:
Hello [Name]!

Thank you for your detailed feedback. We're truly sorry for the confusion and frustration you've experienced. This has caused confusion for many, and we understand how concerning that is.

The sign-up flow should be much clearer, and we sincerely regret that you had to go through such a complicated process just to cancel. Your point about less tech-savvy users struggling with this is valid — and we’re already reviewing ways to simplify it.

Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com — we’ll make sure no further charges occur and assist you with full cancellation.

The Nebula Team 🔮
